subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: one more thing
fact: One more thing happens after she believes she has won.
source_quote: one more thing

subject: potion of flying value
fact: The potion of flying was stolen from the safe and taken by Glabbagool.
source_quote: my Glabbagool arm swipes the potion of flying

subject: red herring coin
fact: One gold coin in the safe had a red herring stamped on it.
source_quote: one of the gold coins had a herring stamped on it, and the herring was red

subject: Deneir's Sanctum
fact: The adventurers were escorted to Deneir's Sanctum to wait out the evening under guard.
source_quote: I will ask him to escort you to Deneir's Sanctum

subject: taster selection
fact: Fembris Lancer was chosen as the taster for the food with the number 118.
source_quote: I'd say 118

subject: sapphire detection
fact: The spell Locate Object found no sapphire on Bookwyrm.
source_quote: I'm hoping she has one on her — that would be interesting. It was not interesting.

subject: safe sealed
fact: The safe was sealed with its contents declared of no interest.
source_quote: They closed the safe with everything still inside... and declared it of no interest.

subject: Kalan reinstated
fact: Kalan Strongbranch was reinstated as head of the Avowed after the investigation.
source_quote: Would you be so willing as to take your position once more?

subject: accusation of accomplices
fact: The group publicly acknowledged the existence of accomplices without naming Bookwyrm.
source_quote: Yeah — we know there are accomplices

subject: Bookwyrm's relief
fact: Bookwyrm was relieved, not heartbroken, upon learning of Alkrist's confession.
source_quote: Alkrist. I could never have imagined it.

subject: Glabbagool's satisfaction
fact: Glabbagool was pleased with the stolen potion of flying and deemed it a good skill.
source_quote: I like the flying skill. That was a good skill.

subject: Alkrist's safe
fact: Alkrist's safe was opened in the presence of the Avowed and found to contain a potion of flying, healing potion, gold, and a red herring coin.
source_quote: A potion of flying. A potion of superior healing. A fat purse of gold coins... one of the gold coins had a herring stamped on it, and the herring was red.

subject: Fembris's punishment
fact: Fembris Lancer was assigned to keep the adventurers company as his penance.
source_quote: Fembris Lancer was already in there, serving out his own punishment by keeping us company.

subject: House arrest avoidance
fact: The adventurers were not under house arrest, but were escorted to Deneir's Sanctum for protection.
source_quote: No, no, no. You currently hold the most important evidence... I'm simply doing this to protect you.
